headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment tools to improve the accuracy of ClearInstall’s lockfile and install-surface auditing, ensuring users are notified of potential risks before installation. Leverage machine learning models for predictive analysis of package dependencies and security threats.
actions: Implement a real-time risk scoring system using machine learning algorithms to predict potential vulnerabilities in npm/PyPI packages.
